data.name: Fragments of Truth: An MCF Story Collector's Edition
data.detailed_description:
GrandMA Studios presents a brand-new spin-off of the Mystery Case Files series, highlighting the agency’s unsung heroes!

Sooner or later, every detective gets their big break, but the stories of these case-cracking rookie heroes are seldom told… until now! With the head of the MCF missing, it’s up to everyone in the agency to pick up the slack.

So, when a high-profile case involving a former Prime Minister comes across the desk of an eager, bright new detective, it’s the perfect chance to make a name for themselves! The former PM is experiencing a strange phenomenon that doctors have been unable to explain. No matter where she goes, mysterious figures that only she can see have been infiltrating her life.

Where did they come from? What do they want, and why did they choose her? There’s only one way to find out! It’s time to make your mark, detective! Grab your badge and get set for a journey through a surreal, untold side-story of the MCF agency in this new Hidden-Object Puzzle Adventure game!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version.

The Collector’s Edition includes:

  • Even more mystery awaits in the bonus chapter!

  • Solve the case in style with the strategy guide!

  • Play and re-play Mini-games and HOPs, earn Achievements, collect all the hidden Marionettes, and solve the bonus Jigsaw Puzzle at last!

  • Enjoy unique wallpapers, concept art, music, movies, and more!

This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game, meaning a specific genre of story-driven, point & click adventures. Throughout the game, players are tasked to find a list of objects hidden within a particular scene, and to occasionally complete various mini-games/puzzles.
